description: This is a database migration script using Alembic for SQLAlchemy, defining upgrade and downgrade functions to modify database schema related to user associations with tables and datasources in the Superset project.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema changes to add user association tables and remove user_id columns from existing tables.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts schema changes made in upgrade, restoring user_id columns and foreign keys, and dropping association tables.
